t: r/whichbike on Reddit: Has anyone heard of Titan Bikes? I got it from a bike shop for free as compensation for and don't know its quality.
s: February 22, 2022 - I can't find much on this brand but noticed a few $300 Titan's on Amazon. ... Not familiar with the brand, but we can make some assumptions. Parts look to be mid level for the '90s (it would be a lot easier to tell with a drive side picture). There's a sticker in the seat tube that says "CrMo Tubes". This means that the front triangle is chromoly (almost certainly single gauge) and the rear triangle is carbon steel. Based on this, I'd guess it's a decent bike (certainly better than Walmart) and can be reliable, but it's nothing special.
